added.summary: A model's import settings state the file's axes that are its front (nose) and up: `model { front "-x" up "+y" }`. The cook turns it so the cooked model faces +Z with +Y up, as the facing guide says; meshes, skins, clips and fracture chunks turn together. A generated or bought model facing another way no longer needs a turn in game code. Axes along one line are refused.

Draws the engine's axes at the model's origin over each view, labelled +Z FRONT (blue), +Y UP (green) and +X (red), and says so in the report's `axes`: a fact an agent can see to check a model's nose before using it.
